Dread,Ⓒs.ⒹBIti f., trAsaH, Baya, sADvasaM.

Ⓔv. t.Ⓓsvapne dfS 1 P.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹsvapnaM dfS, svapnAyate (D.).

Ⓑ

Ⓝ[Dream]y,Ⓒa.Ⓓsvapnopama, svapnavat ind.; asAra.

Dreary,Ⓒa.ⒹGora, nirjana, SUnya, jIrRa.
Ⓑ
 2 nirA-naMda, durAloka, dudarSanaM, nizpraBa.
Ⓝ[Dreary]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹnirjanatvaM, GoratA, SUnyatvaM.

Dregs,Ⓒs.ⒹKalaM, malaH-laM, ucCizwaM, SezaM, kiwwaM, avakaraH, saMkaraH, asAraH; ‘he belongs to the d(regs) of society’ nIca-aDama-tamoyaM puruzaH.
ⓃDreggist,Ⓒa.Ⓓmalina, samala.

Drench,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓklid c., prokz 1 P, sic 6 P, jalena plu c. or snA c. (snA-sna-payati); ‘d(rench)ed with sweat’ svedasalilasnAta.
Ⓔs.ⒹpAnaM, peyaM.

Dress,Ⓒs.ⒹveSaH-zaH, nepaTyaM, vastraM, paricCadaH, vAsas n., vasanaM, pariDAnaM.
Ⓑ
 2 AkalpaH, pari-karman n., ABaraRaM, prasADanaM, BUzaRaM, alaMkAraH, saMskAraH, parizkAraH, maMqanaviDiH.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓpra-sAD c., alaMkf 8 U, parizkf, maMq 10, BUz 10; prA-vf 5 U, vastreRa AcCad 10 or pari-vezw c., saMvye 1 P, vastraM pariDA c. (DApayati).

 2 (Oneself) vas 2 A, vastraM pariDA 3 U,
Ⓑ
 3 upakxp c., saMskf, viDA 3 U, sajjIkf; ‘d(ress) food’ (annaM) pac 1 P, SrA c. (Sra-payati), saMskf, SrI 9 U, sidDIkf; ‘d(ress) hair’ keSAn rac 10 or vinyas 4 P; ‘d(ress) leather’ carma parizkf; ‘d(ress) wounds’ kzataM nirRij 3 U or prakzal 10.
Ⓝ[Dress]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹparicCanna, vastravezwita, saveSa, saMvIta, prAvfta, pra-sADita, maMqita, BUzita, alaMkfta, savAsas, va-strAnvita, kftanepaTya, kftaparikarman, racitaveza, AkalpaH; ‘well d(ressed)’ suveSa, ‘d(ressed) as’ ex. by veSa-vAsas in comp.; ‘d(ressed) as a sage’ muniveSaH, munivezaDArI; ‘d(ressed) in black’ nI-lAMbara.

 3 nirRikta.
Ⓝ[Dress]er,Ⓒs.ⒹprasADakaH, AcCAdakaH, AkalpakaH.
Ⓑ
 2 anna-PalakaH.
Ⓝ[Dress]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹvastrapariDAnaM, nepaTyaviDAnaM-aMgasaMskAraH, parikarman n.
Ⓑ
 2 pAkanizpatti f., annasaMskAraH, pAkasidDi f.
Ⓑ
 3 vilepaH-panaM, upanAhaH; ‘d(ressing) room’ nepaTyaM, prasADanAgAraM, vastrapariDAnasTAnaM.
